send.sent.message: {count, plural, one {Sent to {device}} other {Sent # tabs to {device}}}
send.sent.description: Confirmation after a tab (or several) went to another device that is online. Toast, toolbar tooltip, popup banner. {count} is the number of tabs; {device} is the device's name, e.g. “Pixel 9”.

send.sentQueued.message: {count, plural, one {Sent to {device} — opens when it wakes} other {Sent # tabs to {device}. They open when it wakes.}}
send.sentQueued.description: Confirmation when the tab reached the relay but the target device is asleep or offline, so it opens later. {count} is the number of tabs; {device} is the device's name.

send.sentQueued.detail.message: {count, plural, one {Opens when it wakes} other {They open when it wakes}}
send.sentQueued.detail.description: Second line of the send banner when the target device is asleep. Short. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.multi.all.message: {count, plural, one {Sent to # device} other {Sent to # devices}}
send.multi.all.description: Sent to several devices at once and all are online. {count} is the number of devices.

send.multi.some.message: {count, plural, one {Sent to # device} other {Sent to # devices}} — {offline, plural, other {# opens when it wakes}}
send.multi.some.description: Sent to several devices at once and some are asleep. {count} is the number of devices; {offline} is how many of them are asleep and will open the tab later.

send.offline.message: No connection — will send when you're back online
send.offline.description: Toolbar tooltip when this browser has no internet: the tab is kept and sent later.

send.noDevices.message: No devices yet — pair one to start sending
send.noDevices.description: Message when the person tries to send but has no other device yet.

send.hardError.message: Couldn't send — check Tabsend is still linked
send.hardError.description: Toolbar tooltip when a send failed for a reason Tabsend cannot name, usually because this browser was unlinked.

send.fallback.thatDevice.description: Stands in for a device's name when it is unknown, inside a sentence such as “Your relay doesn't know {device} any more”. Must read as a noun phrase in the middle of a sentence.

send.fallback.device.description: Stands in for a device's name when it is unknown, in “Sent to {device}”. A bare noun.

send.fallback.yourDevice.description: Stands in for a device's name when it is unknown, in banners such as “Sent to {device}”.

send.failure.browserOffline.message: {count, plural, one {You're offline. This tab sends itself as soon as you're back.} other {You're offline. These tabs send themselves as soon as you're back.}}
send.failure.browserOffline.description: Shown when this browser has no internet and the tab is being kept. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.failure.relayUnreachable.message: {count, plural, one {Can't reach your relay at {relayUrl}. The tab is held here and sends itself once the relay answers again.} other {Can't reach your relay at {relayUrl}. The tabs are held here and send themselves once the relay answers again.}}
send.failure.relayUnreachable.description: Shown when the person's relay (the server that passes tabs between devices) does not answer. {relayUrl} is its web address; keep it unchanged. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.failure.relayUnreachablePage.message: {count, plural, one {Can't reach your relay. The tab is held here and sends itself once the relay answers again.} other {Can't reach your relay. The tabs are held here and send themselves once the relay answers again.}}
send.failure.relayUnreachablePage.description: Same as the relay-not-answering message, but for the banner drawn inside a web page, which must not show the relay's address. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.failure.relayBusy.message: {count, plural, one {Your relay is having trouble right now. The tab is held here and sends itself once the relay is answering properly again.} other {Your relay is having trouble right now. The tabs are held here and send themselves once the relay is answering properly again.}}
send.failure.relayBusy.description: Shown when the relay answers with a temporary error. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.failure.unauthorized.message: Your relay doesn't recognise this browser any more. Set Tabsend up again here to start sending.
send.failure.unauthorized.description: Shown when the relay no longer accepts this browser (it was removed or the relay was reset).

send.failure.noTarget.message: Tabsend can't find {device} in your list of devices any more.
send.failure.noTarget.description: The chosen target device is gone from the group. {device} is the device's name, or the phrase “that device”.

send.failure.noTab.message: There's nothing to send from this tab.
send.failure.noTab.description: The current tab has no web page that can be sent (for example a blank tab).

send.failure.givenUp.tooOld.message: {count, plural, one {This tab waited {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} for your relay and was never taken, so Tabsend has stopped holding it. Send it again once the relay is answering.} other {These tabs waited {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} for your relay and were never taken, so Tabsend has stopped holding them. Send them again once the relay is answering.}}
send.failure.givenUp.tooOld.description: Shown when tabs waited too long for the relay and were dropped. {count} is the number of tabs; {days} is how long Tabsend keeps them (currently 7).

send.failure.givenUp.queueFull.message: {count, plural, one {Tabsend holds at most {max, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}} while your relay isn't taking them, and this one was the oldest. Send it again once the relay is answering.} other {Tabsend holds at most {max, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}} while your relay isn't taking them, and these were the oldest. Send them again once the relay is answering.}}
send.failure.givenUp.queueFull.description: Shown when too many tabs piled up while the relay was unreachable, so the oldest were dropped. {count} is how many were dropped; {max} is the limit (currently 200).

send.failure.unknownTarget.message: {count, plural, one {Your relay doesn't know {device} any more. Pair it again, then send this tab a second time.} other {Your relay doesn't know {device} any more. Pair it again, then send these tabs a second time.}}
send.failure.unknownTarget.description: The relay refused because it no longer knows the target device. {device} is the device's name or “that device”; {count} is the number of tabs.

send.failure.expiredKey.message: The keys on {device} have changed since this browser last saw them. Open the Tabsend list once to pick up the new ones, then send again.
send.failure.expiredKey.description: The target device's encryption keys changed. {device} is the device's name or “that device”. “Tabsend list” means the popup's list of devices.

send.failure.notInGroup.message: Your relay says {device} has left your group of devices.
send.failure.notInGroup.description: The relay says the target device is no longer in the person's group. {device} is the device's name or “that device”.

send.cap.pacing.message: {count, plural, one {Your relay is pacing sends for your group right now. This tab is queued and will send itself shortly.} other {Your relay is pacing sends for your group right now. These tabs are queued and will send themselves shortly.}}
send.cap.pacing.description: The relay is limiting how fast tabs can be sent; the tab waits and goes by itself. Same sentence as on Android and iOS. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.cap.holding.message: {count, plural, one {Your relay is holding as much as your group's limit allows. This tab is queued and will send once the receiving device catches up.} other {Your relay is holding as much as your group's limit allows. These tabs are queued and will send once the receiving device catches up.}}
send.cap.holding.description: The relay is full for this group until the receiving device picks up what is waiting. Same sentence as on Android and iOS. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.cap.general.message: {count, plural, one {Your relay has reached a limit for your group. This tab is queued and will send itself once there is room.} other {Your relay has reached a limit for your group. These tabs are queued and will send themselves once there is room.}}
send.cap.general.description: A general limit on the relay is reached; the tab waits. Same sentence as on Android and iOS. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.failure.unexplained.message: Something went wrong inside your relay. It may be worth checking that it is healthy.
send.failure.unexplained.description: Fallback when the relay gives an answer Tabsend has no sentence for.

send.failure.deviceLimit.message: Your relay has reached its device limit for your group. Remove a device you are not using, then pair this one again.
send.failure.deviceLimit.description: The group is full, so this browser could not join. Same sentence as on Android and iOS.

send.failure.error.notFound.description: The relay does not have the target device. {device} is the device's name or “that device”.

send.failure.error.forbidden.message: Your relay wouldn't let this browser send to {device}.
send.failure.error.forbidden.description: The relay refused this browser permission to send to the target. {device} is the device's name or “that device”.

send.failure.error.invalidRequest.message: Your relay didn't understand this send. It's most likely running an older version than this browser. Updating it should fix this.
send.failure.error.invalidRequest.description: The relay did not understand the request, usually because it is older than this extension.

send.failure.error.rateLimited.message: Your relay is busy right now. Give it a moment and send again.
send.failure.error.rateLimited.description: The relay is asking this browser to slow down.

send.failure.error.invalidPairingCode.message: That setup link is no longer valid.
send.failure.error.invalidPairingCode.description: A setup link was refused as expired or already used.

send.failure.error.groupExists.message: Your relay already hosts a group of devices.
send.failure.error.groupExists.description: The relay already has a group and cannot create another.

send.recovered.message: {count, plural, one {{hasTitle, select, yes {Sent “{title}”} other {Sent the tab that was waiting}}} other {Sent # tabs that were waiting}}
send.recovered.description: Toast when tabs that were held back (offline or relay down) have finally been sent. {count} is the number of tabs; {hasTitle} is “yes” when {title}, the page title, is known.

send.dropped.message: {count, plural, one {{hasTitle, select, yes {Couldn't send “{title}”} other {Couldn't send the tab that was waiting}}} other {Couldn't send # tabs that were waiting}}
send.dropped.description: Toast when held-back tabs were finally refused and will not be sent. {count} is the number of tabs; {hasTitle} is “yes” when {title}, the page title, is known.

send.partial.headline.description: Headline when some of several tabs were delivered and the rest refused. {sent} delivered, {count} total, {device} the target's name.

send.partial.refused.description: Second part of a partly-delivered send: how many tabs the relay refused. {count} is that number.

send.partial.line.description: Joins the headline of a partly-delivered send (“Sent 2 of 3 tabs to Pixel”) and its detail into the one-line tooltip. Both parts are sentences; the full stop after {headline} is part of this message.

send.banner.waiting.message: {count, plural, one {Waiting to send to {device}} other {Waiting to send # tabs to {device}}}
send.banner.waiting.description: Headline of the banner when tabs are held and will be sent later. {count} is the number of tabs; {device} the target's name.

send.banner.failed.message: {count, plural, one {Couldn't send to {device}} other {Couldn't send # tabs to {device}}}
send.banner.failed.description: Headline of the banner when a send failed for good. {count} is the number of tabs; {device} the target's name.

send.neverArrived.headline.message: {count, plural, one {A tab never reached {device}} other {# tabs never reached {device}}}
send.neverArrived.headline.description: Headline when tabs were accepted by the relay but the target never picked them up before they expired. {count} is the number of tabs; {device} the target's name.

send.neverArrived.detail.message: {count, plural, one {It waited at your relay until it expired. Tabsend history has it, and can send it again.} other {They waited at your relay until they expired. Tabsend history has them, and can send them again.}}
send.neverArrived.detail.description: Second line of the “never reached” banner. “Tabsend history” is the name of the History page. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.sending.message: {count, plural, one {Sending to {device}} other {Sending # tabs to {device}}}
send.sending.description: Banner shown during the few seconds when a quick send can still be undone. {count} is the number of tabs; {device} the target's name.

send.gone.removed.message: {removedHere, select, yes {{device} was removed from your group.} other {{device} is no longer in your group.}}
send.gone.removed.description: Line under a held tab whose target device left the group. {removedHere} is “yes” when this browser removed it, otherwise the device is just missing. {device} is the device's name or a phrase from send.gone.fallbackDevice.

send.gone.sendTo.description: Label before the buttons for choosing another device for a held tab. Ends with a colon.

send.gone.sendToMenu.description: First entry of the drop-down for choosing another device for a held tab, and its spoken label.

send.gone.noOtherDevice.message: No other device to send it to.
send.gone.noOtherDevice.description: Shown under a held tab when there is no other device it could go to.

send.gone.sendToAria.description: Spoken name (for screen readers) of a button that sends a held tab to a device. {tab} is the tab's title, {device} the device's name.

send.gone.headline.message: {count, plural, one {{hasTitle, select, yes {“{title}” is waiting for a new device} other {A tab is waiting for a new device}}} other {# tabs are waiting for a new device}}
send.gone.headline.description: Banner headline when held tabs lost their target device. {count} is the number of tabs; {hasTitle} is “yes” when {title}, the page title, is known.

send.gone.detail.message: {removedHere, select, yes {{device} was removed from your group.} other {{device} is no longer in your group.}} Open Tabsend to send {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} to another device.
send.gone.detail.description: Banner detail when held tabs lost their target device. {removedHere} is “yes” when this browser removed it. {device} is the device's name or a phrase from send.gone.fallbackDevice. {count} is the number of tabs.

send.gone.fallbackDevice.message: {count, plural, one {The device it was for} other {The device they were for}}
send.gone.fallbackDevice.description: Stands in for the device's name at the START of a sentence when the name is unknown. {count} is the number of held tabs.
